$comment: Single source of truth for the ids the JS product-action bus (dispatchMenuAction/useMenuAction) recognizes. Rust embeds this file and asserts that every id MENU_SPEC bridges from the native macOS menu is one of these (a subset, not an exact match) — see menu_spec_tests.rs. This file may list MORE ids than the native menu bridges: the product-owned title bar's hamburger app menu (desktop-title-bar.tsx) dispatches some of these directly, on every platform, independent of whether a native menu exists.
